mapper.insert: insert into agent_temp_attachment (id, token_id, user_id, project_id, file_id, file_name, content_type, size, purpose, step_num, linked, expires_at, create_time) values (#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tokenId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{size,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stepNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{linked,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: select * from agent_temp_attachment where id = #{id} limit 1

select * from agent_temp_attachment t where linked = 0 and expires_at < #{expiresBefore} and not exists (select 1 from agent_exec_attachment e where e.file_id=t.file_id and (e.exec_log_id is not null or e.exec_history_id is not null)) and not exists (select 1 from agent_temp_attachment other where other.file_id=t.file_id and other.id != t.id and (other.linked=1 or other.expires_at >= #{expiresBefore})) order by expires_at asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
select * from agent_temp_attachment where id = #{id} for update
